itemName.description: The name of the item to be displayed.

truncate.description: An array of two numbers representing the start and end index of the substring to be displayed.

format.description: Transition-altitude presentation for this item. "altitude" uses the system's altitudeFormat and picks the band from the item's own value; "flightLevel" always uses the above-transition band, for values that are always a level. An object overrides the system default inline. Explicit truncate, padWithZeroLeft, prefix or suffix on this item override the matching part.

placeholder.description: A placeholder string to be displayed when the item is empty or equal to 0.

prefix.description: A prefix string to be displayed before the item, it can also be an expression rule.

suffix.description: A suffix string to be displayed after the item, it can also be an expression rule.

mapping.description: A mapping object to map item values to display values, this forces the display value based on the item value you set.

padWithZeroLeft.description: A number to pad the item value with leading zeros.

padWithZeroRight.description: A number to pad the item value with trailing zeros.

fontSize.description: Font size of the itemm can also be an expression rule.

textWeight.description: Fine stroke weight. Negative thins the strokes, positive thickens them, 0 is the font's own weight. Overrides fontWeight.

textSharpness.description: Edge hardness. 0 keeps the rasteriser's own antialiasing, 1 gives a near-binary edge. A negative textWeight with some sharpness gives a thin, crisp look.

fontWeight.description: Font weight of the item, can also be an expression rule.

textAlign.description: Text alignment of the item, can be left, center or right.

lineHeight.description: Line height of the item, can also be an expression rule.

anyOf.description: RGB color array [r,g,b]
RGBA color array [r,g,b,a]
RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

color.description: Color of the item (in RGBA), can also be an expression rule.

blinkColor.description: Blink color of the item (in RGBA), can also be an expression rule.

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the item (in RGBA), can also be an expression rule.

separatorBefore.description: Whether add a blank padding the item.

showPlusMinus.description: Whether to show a plus/minus sign before the item if the item is a number.

value.description: A static value or expression to be displayed instead of the item if the item name is set to text.

leftClick.description: The action to be performed when the item is left-clicked

rightClick.description: The action to be performed when the item is right-clicked

doubleClick.description: The action to be performed when the item is double-clicked, on a radar label as well as in a list.

anyOf.description: Dragging from this item draws the ground track the aircraft would fly to reach the heading under the cursor, turning at the bank angle it can hold, and assigns that heading on release.

leftDrag.description: The tool started by dragging from this item. The item does not move the label while this is set; a click without a drag still fires leftClick.

middleClick.description: The action to be performed when the item is middle-clicked.

tagRow.description: One row of a tag, its items laid out left to right.

labelVariant.description: One tag layout and the conditions that select it. Every selector present must pass and the FIRST variant in the array whose selectors all pass wins, so order is the priority. A variant with no selectors matches everything from its position onwards.

description.description: Free-text note for the author; nothing reads it.

applyToIsArrival.description: Restricts this variant to aircraft that are an arrival.

applyToIsDeparture.description: Restricts this variant to aircraft that are a departure.

detailed.description: True marks the layout shown while the tag is hovered. A detailed variant is a candidate only while hovering, and a hovered tag with no matching detailed variant keeps the compact rows it already had.

rows.description: The rows of the tag, top to bottom. An empty array means this variant draws no tag.

description.description: Description of the style variant (this is not used for anything and is just for you to add note).

applyToIsArrival.description: Whether this style variant should be applied when the aircraft is an arrival.

applyToIsDeparture.description: Whether this style variant should be applied when the aircraft is a departure.

textWeight.description: Fine stroke weight for every item this variant applies to. Negative thins. Overrides fontWeight; a tag item's own textWeight wins over this.

textSharpness.description: Edge hardness for every item this variant applies to, 0 to 1. A tag item's own textSharpness wins over this.

lineHeight.description: Line height of the label text.

textColor.description: Text color of the label (in RGB). This is the default text color for all states.

textColorForState.description: Text color of the label (in RGB) for each attention state. This overrides the default text color.

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the label (in RGB). This is the default background color for all states.

backgroundColorOpacity.description: Background color opacity of the label (0-1). This is the default background color opacity for all states.

roundedCorners.description: Rounded corners of the label (0-100). This is the default rounded corners for all states.

hoverBorderColor.description: Border color of the label when the aircraft is hovered (in RGB).

leaderLineColor.description: Color of the leader line drawn between the aircraft position and the label (in RGB). Omit it and no leader line is drawn for this variant.

detailedLeaderLineColor.description: Color of the leader line while the aircraft is hovered (in RGB). Omit it and the hovered tag keeps leaderLineColor. Set only this key and the leader line is drawn in the detailed (hovered) tag alone.

detailedBackgroundColor.description: Background color of the label when the aircraft is hovered (in RGB). This overrides the default background color.

detailedBackgroundColorOpacity.description: Background color opacity of the label when the aircraft is hovered (0-1). This overrides the default background color opacity.

detailedRoundedCorners.description: Rounded corners of the label when the aircraft is hovered (0-100). This overrides the default rounded corners.

detailedTextColor.description: Text color of the label when the aircraft is hovered (in RGB). This overrides the default text color.

detailedFontSize.description: Font size of the label when the aircraft is hovered. This overrides the default font size.

detailedFontWeight.description: Font weight of the label when the aircraft is hovered. This overrides the default font weight.

tagItemPaddingY.description: Padding of the tag item in the Y direction (top and bottom). The default is 2.

tagItemPaddingX.description: Padding of the tag item in the X direction (left and right). The default is 3.

tagContainerPaddingLeft.description: Padding of the tag container in the left direction. The default is 2.

tagContainerPaddingRight.description: Padding of the tag container in the right direction. The default is 2.

tagContainerPaddingTop.description: Padding of the tag container in the top direction. The default is 2.

tagContainerPaddingBottom.description: Padding of the tag container in the bottom direction. The default is 2.

detailedTagContainerPaddingLeft.description: Padding of the tag container in the left direction when the aircraft is hovered.

detailedTagContainerPaddingRight.description: Padding of the tag container in the right direction when the aircraft is hovered.

detailedTagContainerPaddingTop.description: Padding of the tag container in the top direction when the aircraft is hovered.

detailedTagContainerPaddingBottom.description: Padding of the tag container in the bottom direction when the aircraft is hovered.

section.description: One half of a labels config: the tag layouts in selection order plus the styles.

labels.description: Tag layouts in priority order. The first one whose selectors all pass is used.

styleVariants.description: Tag styles in priority order. The first one whose selectors all pass is used.

Greater than operator, only works with numbers
Greater than or equal to operator, only works with numbers
String begins with operator
String ends with operator
String contains operator

Logical NOT operator

applyWhen.description: An expression that determines when this style variant should be applied. This expression is evaluated in the context of the aircraft.

attentionStates.description: Restricts this variant to aircraft in one of the listed attention states. Omit to apply regardless of attention state.

filterStates.description: Restricts this variant to aircraft in one of the listed display-filter states. An aircraft above the profile's upper altitude filter is kUpperFiltered, one below the lower filter is kLowerFiltered, and any other aircraft is kUnfiltered. OMITTING this key means unfiltered traffic only: filtered traffic is drawn solely by the variants that list its state and there is no fallback, so a system that says nothing about filtered traffic keeps hiding it.

altitudeFormat.description: How altitude-valued tag items render either side of the transition altitude. Declared once per system; items opt in with "format".

prefix.description: Text placed before the digits, e.g. "A" below the transition altitude.

suffix.description: Text placed after the digits, e.g. "00" to render full feet rather than hundreds.

digits.description: MINIMUM digit count of the value in hundreds of feet, zero-padded and never truncated. 2 renders 3000 as "30" and still renders 12000 as "120".

suffix.description: Text placed after the digits, e.g. "00" to render full feet rather than hundreds.
